value.name: Lucia reacts to Daniel's remark
value.description: Lucia makes a startled, emotionally complex reaction as she adjusts her long-held view of Daniel in response to what he has just said.
evidence: Lucia made a small noise. It was not a laugh and not a sound of contempt.

It was the sound of a woman who had not expected her brother to say what he had just said, and who was making, in real time, an adjustment to a story she had been telling herself about him for many years

value.name: Lucia addresses Daniel cautiously
value.description: Lucia begins to speak to Daniel, but he cuts her off before she can continue.

value.name: Daniel demands the memorandum
value.description: Daniel places his hand on the memorandum and turns to Asha to ask what she needs from them.
evidence: He put his hand flat on the memorandum.
"What do you need from us today," he said.

value.name: Asha requests appraisal agreement
value.description: Asha explains that she needs the siblings to agree to an appraisal and choose one of three independent appraisers by the end of the day.
evidence: "I need you to agree to the appraisal. I have three names of independent appraisers. Any one of them is acceptable to my office and to the Register of Wills. I would like you to choose one by the end of business today."
value.time_hint: by the end of business today

value.name: Asha schedules inspection and report
value.description: Asha says she will arrange the inspection and that the appraisal report should be ready within ten days, after which they will meet again.
evidence: "I will arrange the inspection. The report should be available within ten days. We will meet again on the day the report is delivered."

value.name: Asha imposes house restrictions
value.description: Asha instructs the three siblings to remain in, visit, or stay away from the house as they choose, but not remove anything without notice.
evidence: "Between now and then I would like the three of you to live in this house, or visit this house, or stay out of this house, as you each prefer, and to refrain from removing any item from the premises without notice to the other two and to my office."

value.name: Asha forbids removing personal items
value.description: When challenged, Asha clarifies that the no-removal rule includes items the siblings believe are personally or sentimentally theirs.
evidence: "Including objects you believe to be personally yours. Including objects of sentimental rather than financial value."

value.name: Asha singles out Serrano's watch
value.description: Asha specifically warns Mr. Serrano not to remove the watch she saw him examining in the upstairs study.
